description: Upload a PNG/JPEG to the publisher-bound AR project (image_url or small image_base64). Returns asset_id and media_url for row linking.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (optional data: URL prefix stripped). Use only for small images (~150 KB decoded max).

image_url.description: Public https URL to download the image (preferred for large promo assets; avoids MCP env size limits).

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

upload_caption.description: Optional asset caption stored on the AR asset row.

upload_filename.description: Filename hint for multipart upload (e.g. bgpt-chowdeck-square-dark.png).

name: upload_publisher_image
